All five seeds and four arms execute the complete model, EMA, optimizer, CARL, consistency, finite-check, heartbeat, and evaluation paths for 512 training steps plus sixteen structured-haze evaluation forwards per seed-arm cell: exactly 10560 CUDA iterations. BatchNorm mode and buffer equality are checked after every model forward and optimizer or EMA update. Batches contain two distinct synthetic scenes and consistency pairs use distinct observations. The formal map remains 40000 training plus 12000 evaluation iterations. The qualification reads no Haze4K image or outcome, trains no scientific weight, and creates no scientific result. Any non-finite, BatchNorm mutation, identity mismatch, or cost violation fails immediately without replacement or omission.
